title: Pilgrim's Pamphlet
text:
COME TO BLOOMHOLLOW, where the candles smell of honey and the bees bless every flame!

The Orchard Chapel welcomes all pilgrims. Beeswax tapers sold at the gate. Mead on feast days.

Someone has written across it in red: CLOSED BY ORDER OF THE WAX SYNOD. And under that, in pencil: they burned the hives first.
